judgments.rationale: Subparagraph (A) (represented by baseline C0000) requires advance notice and a copy of the complaint before filing. Subparagraph (B)(i) (represented by C0001) specifies that Subparagraph (A) does not apply if the attorney general determines that providing advance notice is not feasible. Setting qualifies to C0000 with relation exception accurately reflects this statutory qualification, and the updated actor, action, and summary faithfully adhere to F006 without conflating the separate notification duty in clause (ii).

Clause (i) (C0001) exempts an action from the pre-filing notice requirements of Subparagraph (A) (C0000). It does not qualify clause (ii) (C0002); rather, C0002 imposes an affirmative simultaneous notice duty for actions described in clause (i). Therefore, targeting C0002 under qualifies is incorrect. Additionally, the summary improperly conflates C0001 with the separate duty in C0002.

The proposed summary incorporates the affirmative requirement that the attorney general must provide notice and a copy of the complaint at the same time as filing. That duty arises under clause (ii) (Notification, C0002) rather than clause (i) (Exemption In general, C0001), improperly conflating two distinct statutory provisions.

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.


(B) Exemption

(i) In general

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.

Additionally, the summary improperly conflates C0001 with the separate duty in C0002.

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.


(ii) Notification
